title: Tiny Wings
notes: Physical ARM64 test on 2026-10-07 with IPA SHA-256 fe96bb0b8be295b4031fdee05dadff8f86cf503ee08b6841982cda29a6132499. Startup shows a black frame before the menu. Play and tutorial Next respond to touch. A touch starts the day; a held touch moves the bird down the hill and the score increases. The first day reached a Day Over result with score 1266, and Play Again opened another day. The menu has a large opaque white rectangle over its upper-left text/art, and small colored pixels are visible in gameplay. These rendering defects remain. Only basic touch was checked; sound, saves, longer play and performance were not verified.
